legal_units.title: Deduction on certain premium.
legal_units.text: The following sums shall be allowed as deduction in computing income chargeable under section 26, being premium paid:—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 30 Deduction on certain premium. The following sums shall be allowed as deduction in computing income chargeable under section 26, being premium paid:—

legal_units.title: Deduction on certain premium.
legal_units.text: by any assessee in respect of insurance against risk of damage or destruction of stocks or stores used for the purposes of business or profession;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 30 Deduction on certain premium. The following sums shall be allowed as deduction in computing income chargeable under section 26, being premium paid:— Section 30(a): by any assessee in respect of insurance against risk of damage or destruction of stocks or stores used for the purposes of business or profession;

legal_units.title: Deduction on certain premium.
legal_units.text: by a federal milk co-operative society to effect or to keep in force an insurance on the life of the cattle owned by a member of a co-operative society, being a primary society engaged in supplying milk raised by its members to such federal milk co-operative society;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 30 Deduction on certain premium. The following sums shall be allowed as deduction in computing income chargeable under section 26, being premium paid:— Section 30(b): by a federal milk co-operative society to effect or to keep in force an insurance on the life of the cattle owned by a member of a co-operative society, being a primary society engaged in supplying milk raised by its members to such federal milk co-operative society;

legal_units.title: Deduction on certain premium.
legal_units.text: by the assessee as an employer, through any mode of payment other than cash, to effect or to keep in force an insurance on the health of its employees under a scheme framed in this behalf by—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 30 Deduction on certain premium. The following sums shall be allowed as deduction in computing income chargeable under section 26, being premium paid:— Section 30(c): by the assessee as an employer, through any mode of payment other than cash, to effect or to keep in force an insurance on the health of its employees under a scheme framed in this behalf by—

legal_units.title: Deduction on certain premium.
legal_units.text: the General Insurance Corporation of India formed under section 9 of the General Insurance Business (Nationalisation) Act, 1972 (57 of 1972) and approved by the Central Government; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 30 Deduction on certain premium. The following sums shall be allowed as deduction in computing income chargeable under section 26, being premium paid:— Section 30(c): by the assessee as an employer, through any mode of payment other than cash, to effect or to keep in force an insurance on the health of its employees under a scheme framed in this behalf by— Section 30(c)(i): the General Insurance Corporation of India formed under section 9 of the General Insurance Business (Nationalisation) Act, 1972 (57 of 1972) and approved by the Central Government; or

legal_units.title: Deduction on certain premium.
legal_units.text: any other insurer and approved by the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority established under section 3(1) of the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999 (41 of 1999).
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 30 Deduction on certain premium.
